title: Bounded self-heal policy
description: Strict policy for independently gated observation and repair. Large canonical second and byte counts use documented smaller units so repository text cannot resemble a brokerage account identifier.

$schema.description: Pins this document to the strict local draft-07 schema instead of relying on an editor-selected policy.

enabled.description: Operator kill switch for repair only; observation remains ungated. The shipped false default requires an explicit operator edit before the new PR-writing path can run.

max_repairs_per_day.description: Explicit UTC-day admission ceiling. The shipped value implements the operator's once-per-day requirement independently of every other gate.

max_repairs_per_epoch.description: Cumulative admitted-or-abandoned repair ceiling. It never resets automatically, so only a human new-epoch action can restore lifetime capacity.

breaker_failure_threshold.description: Any this-many unsuccessful repairs in the current epoch latch the breaker. Failures need not be consecutive, preventing alternating outcomes from dodging the stop.

max_attempts_per_fingerprint.description: Per-fingerprint attempt ceiling. Reaching it quarantines the incident so a recurrence cannot consume repair capacity forever.

max_tick_seconds.description: Whole-tick deadline enforced by the out-of-process supervisor, including configuration, state, collection, reconciliation, and repair work.

max_wall_clock_seconds.description: Local elapsed-time allowance reserved for one repair. It bounds execution and contributes to the repair's worst-case minute charge.

monthly_actions_minutes.description: Actions-minute allowance for one monotonic budget period. Admission reserves before dispatch so unsettled work cannot overspend silently.

ci_worst_case_minutes.description: Worst-case CI reservation for every workflow run on a repair PR's head SHA; an unsettled review lease is charged at this amount.

max_forward_skew_minutes.description: Largest accepted single forward wall-clock jump, in whole minutes. The loader converts it to max_forward_skew_seconds so jumps cannot manufacture a fresh period.

max_cumulative_skew_minutes.description: Cumulative accepted forward skew per epoch, in whole minutes. The loader converts it to seconds and additionally requires it to be strictly shorter than budget_period_hours.

max_archive_kib_per_incident.description: Per-incident as-captured private archive cap in KiB. The loader converts it to max_archive_bytes_per_incident; any truncation must be recorded.

max_archive_64kib_blocks_per_run.description: Aggregate private archive cap in 64-KiB blocks. Integer blocks preserve the exact lower bound; the loader converts them to max_archive_bytes_per_run.

budget_period_hours.description: Duration of the durable monotonic budget period in whole hours, converted by the loader to budget_period_seconds instead of deriving resets directly from wall-calendar boundaries.

review_lease_days.description: Maximum time a repair may remain in review before it is refused and its unsettled CI reservation is charged at worst case.

execution_lease_seconds.description: Dispatch lease before a crashed or wedged repair becomes an abandonment that consumes an attempt and worst-case reservation.
